title.zh: 按下开关的那一刻，电是从哪儿来的
title.en: Where the Power Comes From the Instant You Flip the Switch

desc.zh: 电网几乎存不住电，每一瞬间发电都要等于用电。十个可以拖动的模型：转动惯量与频率、调速器、当一天调度员、高压输电的线损、变压器、三相电、电价的优先顺序、鸭子曲线、储能和一次连锁停电。
desc.en: The grid stores almost nothing, so generation must match use every instant. Ten models you can push: inertia and frequency, governors, a day as grid operator, high-voltage line loss, the transformer, three phases, merit-order prices, the duck curve, storage and a cascading blackout.

desc.zh: 发电少于用电时，差额从发电机转子的动能里出，频率按摇摆方程下降；惯量越小掉得越快。
desc.en: When generation falls short, the gap is drawn from the spinning rotors and frequency falls by the swing equation; less inertia means a faster fall.

zh: 为什么电网频率是50赫兹

title.zh: 调速器下垂与自动发电控制
title.en: Governor droop and automatic generation control

desc.zh: 调速器按频率偏差开大汽门，几秒内止住下跌但留下偏差；自动发电控制在几十秒到几分钟里把频率拉回 50 赫兹。
desc.en: Governors open their valves in proportion to the frequency error, arresting the fall within seconds but leaving an offset; AGC brings it back to 50 Hz over minutes.

desc.zh: 一天里用电一直在涨落，机组出力每小时只能爬有限的量；爬得不够快，频率就出界。
desc.en: Demand rises and falls all day while plants can only ramp so fast per hour; ramp too slowly and frequency leaves its band.

desc.zh: 送同样的功率，电压翻倍电流减半，线上发热 I²R 只剩四分之一。
desc.en: For the same power, doubling the voltage halves the current and cuts the I²R heating in the line to a quarter.

title.en: The transformer and AC vs DC

desc.zh: 变压器两边电压之比等于匝数之比，但只对交流有效；这决定了交流赢下电流之战，高压直流后来又在远距离回归。
desc.en: A transformer's voltage ratio equals its turns ratio, but only for AC; that settled the war of the currents, and HVDC later returned for long distances.

desc.zh: 三相相差 120°，三个正弦的和为零、功率之和恒定，所以中线几乎不走电流、电机转得平稳；线电压是相电压的 √3 倍。
desc.en: Three phases 120° apart sum to zero and deliver constant total power, so the neutral carries almost nothing and motors run smoothly; line voltage is √3 times phase voltage.

title.en: Merit order and the clearing price

desc.zh: 机组按边际成本从低到高排队，最后一台被叫上的决定这一小时所有电的价格；燃气价格变了，排队顺序和价格都会变。
desc.en: Plants queue from cheapest marginal cost up, and the last one called sets the price for that hour; change the gas price and the order and price change.

en: why is power expensive in the evening

title.en: The duck curve and net load

desc.zh: 用电减去太阳能和风电就是其他电厂要补的净负荷；太阳能越多，中午越低、傍晚的爬坡越陡，还会出现弃电。
desc.en: Demand minus solar and wind is the net load other plants must cover; more solar means a lower midday, a steeper evening ramp and curtailment.

desc.zh: 储能中午充电、傍晚放电，削掉晚高峰；它由功率、能量和往返效率三个数决定，效率约 80% 意味着每存五度丢一度。
desc.en: Storage charges at midday and discharges in the evening to shave the peak; it is set by power, energy and round-trip efficiency, and about 80% means losing one unit in five.

desc.zh: 丢了一台机组或一条线，潮流挤到别的线上，过载跳闸会连锁扩大；低频减载主动切掉一部分用户，保住其余的人。
desc.en: Lose a plant or a line and power crowds onto other lines, which can trip in a cascade; under-frequency load shedding cuts some customers on purpose to save the rest.
